acceptanceCriteria: The protocol-owned parameter definitions are the sole source for CLI and MCP transport names, requiredness, defaults, enum values, wire types, and descriptions; adapters do not repeat those facts as independent literals.
A deterministic interface description and generated reference are projected from the same definitions consumed by CLI and MCP.
Changing one pilot parameter definition changes parser/schema/description/reference behavior through that source, with a regression proving the binding; no lifecycle or language behavior changes.
Description discovery and reference generation remain read-only and do not start verification subprocesses or inspect Work Item history.
goal: Make the work-item outcome interface facts genuinely single-source: transport names, requiredness, defaults, enums, wire types, and descriptions are defined once and consumed by adapters and generated projections.
intent: Eliminate remaining manual duplication in the work-item outcome interface description so one protocol-owned definition drives CLI metadata, MCP schema/validation, and generated references without changing lifecycle, authorization, Outcome language, host delivery, or release behavior.
scope: crates/cockpit-protocol/src/interface_description.rs canonical interface facts and projection helpers
crates/cockpit-cli/src/main.rs work-item outcome parser metadata and capability projection
crates/cockpit-mcp/src/lib.rs outcome schema and argument validation bindings
tests/docs interface reference generator and its deterministic fixture if required
sources: user objective: BAML-style single-source interface discovery remains incomplete
